summary: Verified FIX 1 (Start a Show uses On-Stage profile) and FIX 2 (per-profile live banners + per-profile Stop Show) end-to-end. Backend 5/5 pytest cases passed. Frontend Playwright E2E covered zero-banner / one-banner / multi-banner / per-profile-stop / FIX 1 onstageSelection scoping. All assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: handleStartShow (App.js L1027-1089) reads onstageSelection from state, splits on ':' into {kind,id}, sets startPayload.profile_id when kind==='profile' and startPayload.event_id when kind==='event'. When onstageSelection is null/empty, no profile_id/event_id is sent and backend falls back to default profile. UI test confirmed posting {profile_id: <second_profile_id>} when On Stage is set to that profile.

VERIFIED: handleStopShowForProfile (App.js L1193-1223) posts to /shows/stop with body {profile_id} and re-fetches profiles/events/current show/grouped requests. UI test confirmed only the second profile was cleared, default profile show remained active.

VERIFIED: Requests tab IIFE (App.js L5752-5791) correctly switches between (a) single Start a Show button when no profile has current_show_id and (b) stacked per-profile banners (data-testid=live-show-banner-<profile_id>) with per-profile Stop buttons (stop-show-btn-<profile_id>). Container has data-testid=live-shows-banners only when banners are shown. Banner text format '🎤 Live: <profile_name> (<show_name>)' matches spec exactly.

VERIFIED: Backend POST /shows/start (server.py L6238-6280) honors event_id > profile_id > default-profile precedence. Confirmed with explicit test that passing both event_id and profile_id yields a show tagged with the event's profile_id (not the spurious profile_id).
VERIFIED: Backend POST /shows/stop (server.py L6373-6433) honors event_id > profile_id > default-profile precedence and only clears current_show_id on the targeted profile or event.
Minor (pre-existing, not part of this PR): live banner uses non-semantic <div> with role of banner; consider role='status' or aria-live. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 UI scenarios passed: zero-banner, one-banner, multi-banner, per-profile-stop, FIX 1 onstageSelection scoping)

seed_data_creation: Created a non-default profile if missing: TEST_ProfileB_<hex> (slug test-profileb-<hex>). Created/stopped multiple ephemeral shows (TEST_DefaultShow_<hex>, TEST_SecondShow_<hex>, TEST_OnStageShow_<hex>). All shows were stopped during cleanup; profile rows remain but are clearly marked TEST_. No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression test for this feature is in /app/backend/tests/test_requests_tab_per_profile_shows.py (5 cases). Run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) python -m pytest backend/tests/test_requests_tab_per_profile_shows.py -v`. The test file also creates a second profile when missing (idempotent) and exercises event-precedence. For UI testing, use page.goto(BASE + '/') for login (there is no /login route). For API calls during browser-based tests, run them via page.evaluate fetch() to avoid Cloudflare 1010 bot block on direct urllib requests. data-testid contract: start-a-show-btn, live-shows-banners (container), live-show-banner-<profile_id>, stop-show-btn-<profile_id>.
